messages:
emily_finance: Heads up: PulseGauge (vendor) sent a renewal quote for their SpendLens product. Renewal escalator looks aggressive. Sharing quote.
raj_procure: thanks. what's the term and % increase?
emily_finance: Quote shows 12-month renewal at +18% vs current with a mandatory premium feature bundle. They say new pricing due to model-usage analytics upgrades.
zoe_prod: can we unbundle the premium features? we only use basic reconciliation + anomaly alerts.
mike_infra: also want to confirm if historical exports remain available post-renewal and whether retention limits changed.
vendor_pulse: PulseGauge quote link: https://pulsegauge.example/quote-2026-renewal.pdf
emily_finance: current usage ~650k tokens/month. their quote bumps seat fees too. Need analysis if cheaper to stay + negotiate or move to AuditTrailX/AuditHarbor.
raj_procure: ask for line-item pricing and ability to opt-out of the feature bundle. push for grandfathering current rates for 6 months.
legal_bot: flag: auto-renew with 30-day opt-out, plus escrow clause removed. recommend we request 60-day notice and ability to export archive.
vendor_pulse: PulseGauge replied: can offer a 10% increase if we commit to 12 months and add premium bundle, or keep current features at +5% with 6-month commitment. They can also provide 90-day export access post-termination.
zoe_prod: prefer +5% and 6-month commitment. but insist on archive export and price lock.
emily_finance: compute TCO: if we switch to AuditTrailX at their pilot rates, there's migration cost ~2 eng-weeks + storage + one-time mapping effort.
raj_procure: I'll ask PulseGauge for a formal concession: 6 months at +5% and option to opt-out after 6 months with 30-day notice. If they refuse, we'll escalate to replacement slates.
legal_bot: ensure data portability clause: full nightly export to S3 on demand. also confirm deletion timeline.
mike_infra: add question: do they support incremental replays for backfill reconciliation? that's important.
vendor_pulse: PulseGauge says incremental replay via S3 is supported (fees may apply).
emily_finance: ok put negotiation plan: 1) request +5% for 6 months + nightly S3 export and export retention 180 days 2) no mandatory premium bundle 3) 6-month price lock post-commitment
raj_procure: I'll send the redline. if counteroffer fails, start AuditTrailX pilot.
zoe_prod: include a clause that they must maintain per-route mapping fidelity during the term or provide credits.
legal_bot: I'll add an SLA credit schedule tied to mapping accuracy and export availability.
emily_finance: thanks. ping once redline sent.
raj_procure: will update here after vendor reply.
vendor_pulse: Vendor acknowledges receipt of redline and will review.
emily_finance: thanks all :thumbsup:
